"An Indian tourist named Vijaya Lakshmi Gali fell into an 8-metre-deep sinkhole while walking along a road in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, on 23 August. The pavement beneath her collapsed suddenly, and she disappeared into the ground. Only her slippers have been recovered so far.

***

Rescue teams have been searching for her for over a week, employing tracker dogs, remote cameras, and ground-penetrating radar to locate her.

***

* The search has been officially halted after authorities deemed it too dangerous to continue, citing risks to rescue personnel's safety and health.

***

Two divers briefly entered the sinkhole on Thursday but were pulled out before they could reach an obstacle blocking their path.

***

Officials also noted that a soil slip had occurred at the same location the previous year, suggesting ongoing instability in the area. High-pressure water jets and excavators were used to flush drainage systems and clear debris during the operation."

Is there anything else I can help with?
